`peter-rabbit-first-page.pdf` is the first story page of Beatrix Potter's
*The Tale of Peter Rabbit* (1902), public-domain text and original illustration.
Source: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/14838 ; PDF edition:
https://mlw.media.mit.edu/assets/TheTaleofPeterRabbit.pdf . Original text and
Project Gutenberg license are retained in PROJECT-GUTENBERG-SOURCE.txt.
The fixture reproduces a real glyph-as-word extraction regression.
